A2UI lets AI agents stream rich, interactive user interfaces—forms, cards, tabs, modals, sliders, date pickers, and dashboards—using safe declarative JSON instead of raw HTML or JavaScript. PraisonAIUI ships built-in, end-to-end A2UI support across the React App Shell (style: app), Chat inline surfaces, Split Chat + Canvas, Full-Page Canvas, Artifacts viewer, and Legacy Dashboard (style: dashboard).
